title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol now available on AI Gateway
summary_en: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol from OpenAI are now available on AI Gateway . GPT-6.2 Astra: for complex, multi-step projects, with improvements to implementing and testing changes in existing codebases, following document templates, and computer use GPT-6.2 Sol: for everyday coding, writing, and agent workflows, including building interactive web applications from a written brief Use openai/gpt-6.2-astra or openai/gpt-6.2-sol as the model ID. For the API examples, set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY to your AI Gateway API key . Both models also support the Responses API . For lower latency at higher…
